raw_result_source: GitHub Actions stdout and uploaded artifacts
notes: Observations are boundary pointer-use events, not distinct pointers or all U-internal objects
T pointers copied or tokenized, never passed by raw address to U
VMA categories are mapping provenance, not object identity or lifetime
U fault probes are adversarial source-level injections, not prevalence in normal workloads
memcached fixed-operation counts include 0.5 seconds of asynchronous drain and exclude preload

limitations: t_stack identifies only the executing T thread's stack range
t_image_static denotes readable nonexecutable ELF image storage, not proven named globals
VMA classes identify mapping regions, not allocation identity, object type, or lifetime
t_anon_vma may include malloc arenas and other-thread stacks; it is not a proof of heap ownership
unknown means maps inspection unavailable; t_unmapped means no covering VMA was found
uninstrumented pointers are not counted
u_tracked_heap requires a successful SP3 check; U stack and globals remain unclassified
counts denote pointer observations, not unique objects
T pointer addresses remain in T and are copied or tokenized, not passed raw into U
rsync.scope: normal correctness cases; adapter pointer arguments and copies; checked sandbox results
